# harborpilot_gateway_credential (Resource)

A gateway credential (bearer token) for a client binding. Every argument change issues a new credential and revokes the old one. The token itself is not stored unless `store_token_in_state` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harborpilot_gateway_credential" "laptop" {
  binding_id = harborpilot_client_binding.claude_code.id
  name       = "laptop"
  # The token is not stored in state. Issue one with
  # `harbor-pilot token issue`, or use the harborpilot_gateway_token
  # ephemeral resource, or opt in explicitly:
  # store_token_in_state = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `binding_id` (String) Client binding id.
- `name` (String) Label shown in the UI and activity.

### Optional

- `bound_refs` (Map of String) Trusted external references bound at issue time (for example a run id). Requests using the token carry them as trusted context.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Scopes. Default: `gateway:invoke`, `gateway:models`.
- `store_token_in_state` (Boolean) Keep the issued token in Terraform state (`token`). Off by default: state is not a secret store. Prefer the `harborpilot_gateway_token` ephemeral resource (Terraform 1.10+) to hand a token to another provider without storing it.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Lifetime in seconds; `0` = no expiry. An expired credential is removed from state and issued again on the next apply.

### Read-Only

- `base_urls` (Map of String) Gateway base URLs by client protocol.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry (RFC 3339), null when it never expires.
- `id` (String) Credential id.
- `prefix` (String) Non-secret token prefix.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer token, only when `store_token_in_state = true`; otherwise null.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The token cannot be recovered on import.
terraform import harborpilot_gateway_credential.laptop <binding_id>/<credential_id>
```
